newsitem.title: USA: GranCare to acquire Northport Health Svcs.
newsitem.headline: GranCare to acquire Northport Health Svcs.

text.p: GranCare Inc said Wednesday it signed an agreement to acquire Northport Health Services Inc, an Alabama-based long-term care provider with annual revenues of just under $100 million.
GranCare said in a release that the agreement provides for the acquisition of 19 skilled nursing and assisted living facilities with over 2,000 beds and several related ancillary businesses.
The purchase consideration, the company said, includes seller financing and GranCare common stock.
The transaction is expected to close during the second quarter of 1997, the company said.
